seed.description: Release Workflow Hardening step 4 changed from running npm run check to running only npm run check:json and npm run check:shell, on the reasoning that CI already runs the rest. It is a defect because the release must run the same checks before npm publish, so a metadata, command-surface, runtime-hook or pack failure no longer blocks publishing. It contradicts requirement 7 in requirements.md (release runs npm run check before npm publish), and the acceptance criterion at spec.md line 110 (release.yml runs npm run check before publishing).

seed_verification.command: diff -u clean/spec.md seeded/spec.md; grep -n 'npm run check' seeded/spec.md (run from .skill-eval/review-pilot/fixtures/ra-spec-contradiction)
seed_verification.clean_result: spec.md: step 4 (line 82) runs npm run check; acceptance criterion line 110 agrees with requirements.md point 7; no conflicting lines found by reading both sections; 113 lines
seed_verification.seeded_result: spec.md: step 4 (line 82) runs only npm run check:json and npm run check:shell; the line-110 acceptance criterion and requirements.md point 7 still require npm run check before publishing; diff shows exactly one changed line (82); 113 lines
seed_verification.evidence: requirements.md line 13 (point 7): '`.github/workflows/release.yml` runs `npm run check` before `npm publish`.' vs seeded spec.md line 82 (under '### 3. Release Workflow Hardening', line 75): '4. Run `npm run check:json` and `npm run check:shell`, since CI already runs the rest.' Also spec.md line 110 (Acceptance Criteria): '`.github/workflows/release.yml` runs `npm run check` before publishing.'
